source_hypotheses.required: Actual lattice unramified outside finite support including2 and twist primes; qcqs open immersion and henselian arithmetic DVRs.
source_hypotheses.constructed: N_sup contains2 and the full actual odd support, independently of the elliptic conductor.
source_hypotheses.justification: The revised definition matches Kato1999 support modulus; the actual open immersion is affine and the comparison is on finite coefficients first.

constructed_objects.required: Compare ordinary j_* cohomology with open etale cohomology, not an unidentified G_S complex.
constructed_objects.constructed: X=Spec O_K[1/2], U=Spec O_K[1/N_sup]; cone(i_*M→Ri_*M) supported on the deleted odd places.
constructed_objects.justification: Ordinary i_*M=j_*M by stalks; derived stalk and Leray identify the quotient with local unramified-to-full cones.

index_domain_coverage.required: All finite coefficient precisions and all cofinal cyclotomic layers, every deleted odd place and the local2 term.
index_domain_coverage.constructed: Use T/2^aT at each layer, sum over all places above the fixed rational support; cofinal layers are imaginary.
index_domain_coverage.justification: Finite direct sums and compatible transitions preserve the entire actual support; no prime is omitted because it is absent from the untwisted conductor.

transition_maps.required: Coefficient reductions, cyclotomic trace maps, local restrictions and completion identifications must commute.
transition_maps.constructed: Finite etale layer maps on X induce the same traces as Kato; local maps sum over places. Completion equivalence preserves inertia and finite-extension cohomological maps.
transition_maps.justification: Hensel/09EJ identify finite separable categories and residue quotients; naturality of stalk/direct-image maps yields the compatible triangle.

limiting_object_identity.required: The two actual published ordinary inverse-limit groups must be those compared; same Euler-system class and J.
limiting_object_identity.constructed: Finite coefficient cohomology systems are Mittag-Leffler. A cofinal diagonal computes the two limits; no lim1 correction enters.
limiting_object_identity.justification: Finite open/local cohomology and the exact triangle give finite j_* groups. Exact inverse limits preserve the sequence. The resulting H1 isomorphism carries the same class, and finite presentation permits Hom/evaluation ideal localization.

coefficient_conventions.required: Retain T, finite2-power quotients, rational sign component, height-one localization and actual Frobenius action.
coefficient_conventions.constructed: Only after inverse limits tensor Q2, apply the sign idempotent and localize. Use inertia H1, not inertia invariants, for odd local cones.
coefficient_conventions.justification: These are exact operations and the separately accepted local-cone convention; no degree division or replacement of the Euler class is introduced.

local_conditions.required: H2(C_j) must equal the kernel of all odd local restrictions; then impose the local2 kernel.
local_conditions.constructed: Nonzero local determinants kill local-cone H1 after the specified localization; the unramified residue complex has no H2 or higher.
local_conditions.justification: The long exact sequence gives the H1 isomorphism and H2 injection; H2 of each cone is full local H2 by residue cohomological dimension1. The map is the natural local restriction.

exceptional_cases.required: Retain bad odd primes and active twists, the prime2 and archimedean behavior without extending an odd-only argument.
exceptional_cases.constructed: Bad-prime inertia H1 is retained; local2 is imposed only after odd kernel comparison. Cofinal imaginary layers have no real-place term.
exceptional_cases.justification: The separate local-cone result supplies the actual nonzero determinant/active cases; no old bad-prime vanishing or finite-character specialization is inferred.

downstream_consumption.required: Use Theorem0.8 on the same actual class and zero-subscript H2 group in the convention of K15.
downstream_consumption.constructed: Candidate13862–13868 uses the H1/coordinate-ideal and zero-subscript comparison to carry the stated Kato0.8 bound to K15.
downstream_consumption.justification: This transports the already stated theorem application only. Nonvanishing, residual/open-image hypotheses, and all earlier Euler-system relations remain separately supplied.

dependency_impact: Only the exact global comparison convention/support definition is clarified. The accepted finite-coefficient localization and completion bridge compare the original classes and H2 kernels. This does not reprove or expand Kato0.8 hypotheses, the odd local determinant proof, earlier norm relations, or final Version14 closure.
